name: Mithral Armor
summary: Light, flexible armor that imposes no Disadvantage on Stealth and has no Strength requirement.

stats.baseItem: Any Medium or Heavy, Except Hide Armor
stats.effect: Mithral is a light, flexible metal. Armor made of this substance can be worn under normal clothes. If the armor normally imposes Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks or has a Strength requirement, the mithral version of the armor doesn't.
